2688-the-clue-of-the-twisted-candle.creator: Edgar Wallace
2688-the-clue-of-the-twisted-candle.description: A book by Edgar Wallace. “shockers,” he had a large and increasing public who were fascinated by the wholesome and thrilling stories he wrote, and who held on breathlessly to the skein of mystery until they came to the denouement he had planned.

75918-stories-of-cape-cod.creator: Unknown
75918-stories-of-cape-cod.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. George Washington saw its military value. In 1776, when he was in Boston, planning to send troops to New York, Washington observed that this “interior barrier should be cut in order to give greater security to navigation, and against the enemy.”

8161-fragments-of-ancient-poetry.title: Fragments Of Ancient Poetry
8161-fragments-of-ancient-poetry.creator: James Macpherson
8161-fragments-of-ancient-poetry.description: A book by James Macpherson. y it would not have seemed so odd. In fact, as young men both Scott and Byron would have probably have been flattered by such an association. Scott tells us that in his youth he "devoured rather than perused" Ossian and that he could repeat whole duans "without remorse"; and, as I shall discuss later, Byron paid Macpherson the high compliment of writing an imitation of Ossian, which he published in _Hours of Idleness_.

arxiv-2110-11089.title: Self-doping and the Mott-Kondo scenario for infinite-layer nickelate superconductors
arxiv-2110-11089.creator: Yi-feng Yang, Guang-Ming Zhang
arxiv-2110-11089.description: Abstract We give a brief review of the Mott-Kondo scenario and its consequence in the recently-discovered infinite-layer nickelate superconductors. We argue that the parent state is a self-doped Mott insulator and propose an effective t t - J J - K K model to account for its low-energy properties.

arxiv-2112-09161.title: Constraint-based graph network simulator
arxiv-2112-09161.creator: Yulia Rubanova, Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Tobias Pfaff, Peter Battaglia
arxiv-2112-09161.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yulia Rubanova, Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Tobias Pfaff, Peter Battaglia. In the area of physical simulations, nearly all neural-network-based methods directly predict future states from the input states. However, many traditional simulation engines instead model the constraints of the system and select the state which satisfies them. Here we present a framework for constraint-based learned simulation, where a scalar constraint function is implemented as a graph neural network, and future predictions are computed by solving the optimization problem defined by the learned constraint.

arxiv-2211-01086.title: Generative Poisoning Using Random Discriminators
arxiv-2211-01086.creator: Dirren van Vlijmen, Alex Kolmus ∗, Zhuoran Liu ∗, Zhengyu Zhao, Martha Larson
arxiv-2211-01086.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dirren van Vlijmen, Alex Kolmus ∗, Zhuoran Liu ∗, Zhengyu Zhao, Martha Larson. We introduce ShortcutGen, a new data poisoning attack that generates sample-dependent, error-minimizing perturbations by learning a generator. The key novelty of ShortcutGen is the use of a randomly-initialized discriminator, which provides spurious shortcuts needed for generating poisons.

arxiv-2306-17017.title: Growth of the Higgs Field for Kapustin-Witten solutions on ALE and ALF gravitational instantons
arxiv-2306-17017.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Growth of the Higgs Field for Kapustin-Witten solutions on ALE and ALF gravitational instantons Michael Bleher 2 2 2 mbleher@mathi.uni-heidelberg.de Institute for Mathematics, Heidelberg University, Im Neuenheimer Feld 205, Heidelberg, Germany. arxiv-2404-13548.title: The impact of tidal migration of hot Jupiters on the rotation of Sun-like main-sequence stars
arxiv-2404-13548.creator: Shuai-Shuai Guo
arxiv-2404-13548.description: Abstract The tidal interactions of planets affect the stellar evolutionary status and the constraint of their physical parameters by gyrochronology. In this work, we incorporate the tidal interaction and magnetic braking of the stellar wind into MESA and calculate a large grid of 25000 models, covering planets with masses of 0.1-13.

arxiv-2409-11767.title: Bright unintended electromagnetic radiation from second-generation Starlink satellites
arxiv-2409-11767.creator: C. G. Bassa ,, F. Di Vruno , ⋆, B. Winkel , ⋆, G. I. G. Józsa , ⋆, M. A. Brentjens, X. Zhang
arxiv-2409-11767.description: Abstract We report on the detection of unintended electromagnetic radiation (UEMR) from the second-generation of Starlink satellites. Observations with the LOFAR radio telescope between 10 to 88 MHz and 110 to 188 MHz show broadband emission covering the frequency ranges from 40 to 70 MHz and 110 to 188 MHz from the v2-Mini and v2-Mini Direct-to-Cell Starlink satellites.

arxiv-2502-06286.title: Stability and interpolation estimates of Hellinger–Reissner virtual element spaces
arxiv-2502-06286.creator: Michele Botti, Lorenzo Mascotto, Giuseppe Vacca, Michele Visinoni
arxiv-2502-06286.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michele Botti, Lorenzo Mascotto, Giuseppe Vacca, Michele Visinoni. We prove stability and interpolation estimates for Hellinger–Reissner virtual elements; the constants appearing in such estimates only depend on the aspect ratio of the polytope under consideration and the degree of accuracy of the scheme. We further investigate numerically the behaviour of the constants appearing in the stability estimates on sequences of badly-shaped polytopes and for increasing degree of accuracy. AMS subject classification : 65N12; 65N30.

arxiv-2508-00354.title: Omni-Scan: Creating Visually-Accurate Digital Twin Object Models Using a Bimanual Robot with Handover and Gaussian Splat Merging
arxiv-2508-00354.creator: Tianshuang Qiu, Zehan Ma, Karim El-Refai, Hiya Shah, Chung Min Kim, Justin Kerr, Ken Goldberg
arxiv-2508-00354.description: Abstract 3D Gaussian Splats (3DGSs) are 3D object models derived from multi-view images. Such “digital twins” are useful for simulations, virtual reality, E-commerce, robot policy fine-tuning, and part inspection. 3D object scanning usually requires multi-camera arrays, precise laser scanners, or robot wrist-mounted cameras, which have restricted workspaces.

arxiv-2511-19790.title: Asgard/NOTT: L-band nulling interferometry at the VLTI
arxiv-2511-19790.creator: Ahmed Sanny, Lucas Labadie, Simon Gross, Kévin Barjot, Romain Laugier, Germain Garreau, Marc-Antoine Martinod, Denis Defrère, Michael J. Withford
arxiv-2511-19790.description: Abstract Context. The NOTT visitor instrument at the VLTI is designed to characterize hot exozodiacal dust and young Jupiter-like planets at the water snowline via L ′ band nulling interferometry. The beam combination will be achieved by a four-telescope integrated optics beam combiner, which should fulfill specific requirements. Aims.

arxiv-2601-08341.title: From Local Windows to Adaptive Candidates via Individualized Exploratory: Rethinking Attention for Image Super-Resolution
arxiv-2601-08341.creator: Chunyu Meng, Wei Long, Shuhang Gu
arxiv-2601-08341.description: Abstract Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) is a fundamental computer vision task that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) image from a low-resolution (LR) input. Transformer-based methods have achieved remarkable performance by modeling long-range dependencies in degraded images. However, their feature-intensive attention computation incurs high computational cost.

arxiv-2602-17441.title: Delivery of complex organic molecules to the system of Jupiter 2025 Delivery of complex organic molecules to the system of Jupiter – 5
arxiv-2602-17441.creator: Tom Benest Couzinou, Alizée Amsler Moulanier, Olivier Mousis
arxiv-2602-17441.description: Abstract Complex organic molecules are key markers of molecular diversity, and their formation conditions in protoplanetary disks remain an active area of research. These molecules have been detected on a variety of celestial bodies, including icy moons, and may play a crucial role in shaping the current composition of the Galilean moons.

plos-pone-0000579.creator: Christian Iseli, Giovanna Ambrosini, Philipp Bucher et al.
plos-pone-0000579.description: PLOS ONE research article. Searching for matches between large collections of short (14–30 nucleotides) words and sequence databases comprising full genomes or transcriptomes is a common task in biological sequence analysis. We investigated the performance of simple indexing strategies for handling such ta

plos-pone-0003974.title: Bitter Taste Receptors Influence Glucose Homeostasis
plos-pone-0003974.creator: Cedrick D. Dotson, Lan Zhang, Hong Xu et al.
plos-pone-0003974.description: PLOS ONE research article. TAS1R- and TAS2R-type taste receptors are expressed in the gustatory system, where they detect sweet- and bitter-tasting stimuli, respectively. These receptors are also expressed in subsets of cells within the mammalian gastrointestinal tract, where they mediate nutrient assimila

pmc-10600289.title: Interpreting frequentist hypothesis tests: insights from Bayesian inference
pmc-10600289.creator: David Sidebotham, C. Jake Barlow, Janet Martin, Philip M. Jones
pmc-10600289.description: Randomized controlled trials are one of the best ways of quantifying the effectiveness of medical interventions. Therefore, when the authors of a randomized superiority trial report that differences in the primary outcome between the intervention group and the control group are “significant” (i.e., P ≤ 0.05), we might assume that the intervention has an effect on the outcome.

pmc-12620670.title: Octanoic Acid‐Rich Enteral Nutrition Regulates Intestinal M1/M2 Macrophage Polarization via the PPARγ/STAT‐1/STAT‐6 Pathway to Alleviate Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-12620670.creator: Liang Xue, Chun Cao
pmc-12620670.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a complex chronic intestinal inflammatory disease involving immune, genetic and environmental interactions. A disrupted balance in the polarization of intestinal macrophages is a key pathogenic link. This study explored whether octanoic acid (OA)‐rich enteral nutrition (EN) regulated intestinal M1/M2 macrophage polarization via the PPARγ/STAT‐1/STAT‐6 pathway to alleviate IBD.

pmc-12994517.title: Adapting Yoga Therapy to Meet the Needs of Inpatients Undergoing Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Insights From an International, Multisite, Qualitative Study
pmc-12994517.creator: Smitha Mallaiah, Vijaya Majumdar, Scherezade K Mama, Amanda L Olson, May Daher, Yamuna Badgare, Nataraj Kolar Srinivasrao, Stella Rwezaula, Peter Muhoka, Raghavendra Rao, Sachin Jadav, Richard Wagner, Anna Wilson, Manjunath Nandi Krishnamurthy, Lorenzo Cohen
pmc-12994517.description: PURPOSEYoga therapy (YT) is a growing mind-body approach in oncology. However, its integration into hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) remains limited, particularly in non-Western and resource-constrained settings. This formative qualitative study aimed to explore the lived experiences of HSCT patients in the United States, India, and Tanzania to inform the development of a culturally adapted YT protocol.

pmc-13083810.title: Comparison and optimization of cellular neighbor preference methods for quantitative tissue analysis
pmc-13083810.creator: Chiara Schiller, Miguel A Ibarra-Arellano, Kresimir Bestak, Jovan Tanevski, Denis Schapiro
pmc-13083810.description: Studying the spatial distribution of cell types in tissues is essential for understanding their function in health and disease. A widely applied measure in spatial omics analysis is the pairwise neighbor preference of cell types, indicating whether two cell types frequently occur in close proximity to each other.

pmc-13084936.title: Incidence and risk factors of spondylolysis in youth football: a longitudinal study among male Norwegian players
pmc-13084936.creator: Nicolay Morland, David Tovi, Benjamin Clarsen, Cecilie B Rygh, Lena Kristin Bache-Mathiesen, Hege Havstad Clemm, Hilde Gundersen
pmc-13084936.description: ObjectivesSpondylolysis is a common source of low back pain (LBP) among adolescent athletes. We aimed to investigate the occurrence of LBP and spondylolysis, and the potential associations of weekly training and match exposure, and maturity status with spondylolysis among male youth football players.MethodsMale players (n=98) from six teams were followed over three consecutive seasons (U15–U17).

pmc-13216348.title: Spontaneous emergence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction via field-cooling-induced interface engineering in 2D ferromagnetic ternary tellurides
pmc-13216348.creator: Shian Xia, Yan Luo, Iftikhar Ahmed Malik, Xinyi Zhou, Keying Han, Yue Sun, Haoyun Lin, Hanqing Shi, Xiaoze Liu, Yingchun Cheng, Vanessa Li Zhang, Yi Du, Sheng Liu, Chao Zhu, Ting Yu
pmc-13216348.description: Room-temperature skyrmions in the two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2 (FGaT) hold great promise for spintronics. However, the origin of the necessary Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) within its centrosymmetric lattice remains elusive. Here, we reveal a spontaneous DMI emergence mechanism driven by field cooling (FC) in FGaT and its analog Fe3GeTe2 (FGeT).

pmc-13401892.title: Access to Reserve Antibiotics in Latin America and the Caribbean: Situation, Challenges, and Future Directions
pmc-13401892.creator: Susana Ribeiro, Yanina Nuccetelli, Wanda Cornistein, Maria Ines Staneloni
pmc-13401892.description: Access to Reserve antibiotics, which are defined by the World Health Organization’s AWaRe (Access, Watch, Reserve) classification framework as last-resort treatments for multidrug-resistant infections, remains poorly documented in Latin America and the Caribbean despite evidence of increasing antimicrobial resistance in the region, with associated and attributable mortality projected to rise.

pmc-13476533.title: Intravenous amino acids to prevent acute kidney injury in cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials☆
pmc-13476533.creator: Alexandre N. Pantaleao, Antonio Mutarelli, Jagdip Kang, Marcelo A.P. Braga, Felipe S. Passos, Tulio Caldonazo, Hristo Kirov, Torsten Doenst, Aranya Bagchi, Serguei Melnitchouk
pmc-13476533.description: BackgroundThe efficacy of intravenous amino acids (AA) in preventing cardiac surgery-associated acute kidney injury (CSA-AKI) remains uncertain.MethodsThree libraries were searched for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing intravenous AA versus placebo or standard care to reduce the risk of CSA-AKI after cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB). The primary endpoint was the incidence of CSA-AKI, overall and stratified by KDIGO stage.

pmc-13574284.title: Bone FGF23 expression and renal regulatory responses to excess phosphate consumption by juvenile swine
pmc-13574284.creator: Mariola Grez-Capdeville, Brittney P Kokinos, Laura A Amundson, Thomas D Crenshaw
pmc-13574284.description: Fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23), a bone-derived hormone, regulates phosphorus (P) homeostasis by modulation of renal P excretion and vitamin D metabolism. Physiological roles of FGF23 have been mainly characterized in human disorders of P metabolism and murine models. This study aimed to validate roles of FGF23 in P homeostasis in a large animal, healthy swine model.
